description: Select several layers at once in the Layers panel, for commands that act on the selected layers: set or add to the selection, select All Layers, Deselect Layers, Select Linked Layers, Similar Layers (same kind as the target), or find layers whose names contain some text (Select menu). Returns the selected layers

action.description: set: select exactly the target layers; add: add them; all, none; linked and similar: start from the target layer; find: select layers whose name contains query

query.description: find: text the layer name contains, ignoring case

target.description: set and add: the layers; linked and similar: the layer to start from (default the active layer)

names.description: Layer names (every layer with each name)

name: set_layer_selection
title: Set Layer Selection
